finding: FIX WORKS, BAR NOT MET FOR A NEW METRIC-SIDE REASON. The assigned AI fix is CONFIRMED CORRECT: v2 no longer sends its TECN to the $0 Logistics Center and instead CAPTURES the nearest OILB (~t1550) and still owns it at match end. But resources_earned is still 0 because it reports PlayerResources.Earned, which in WW3MOD's SR-budget economy only rises on a NET-POSITIVE periodic unified-economy tick (PassiveIncome + TotalBuildingIncome - Upkeep, PlayerResources.cs:199-211 -> ChangeCash -> GiveCash -> Earned). Both bots read Earned=0 the ENTIRE match, before AND after the capture, and the harvester/GiveResources path that credits Earned directly is never used (no harvesters). A single captured $50 derrick does not produce a positive, Earned-crediting net, so Earned is structurally blind to owned-derrick income here. capture_income score component also stayed 0. This is a HARNESS/METRIC defect, not a v2 behavior gap. CashTrickler correctly re-registers income under the capturing owner (CashTrickler.cs:71-76) and bots are Playable (map default), so those are ruled out. Full evidence: runs/260719_s1_earned_metric_finding.md.
